text:
Situation: Nitrofurantoin 50 mg capsules are not on FDA's drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 353 capsules at 13.7 per day (25.7 days on hand). Corvale General holds 409 capsules at 15.9 per day (25.7 days on hand). Corvale Lakeside holds 29 capsules (11.4 days on hand). FDA's shortage list shows Amneal Pharmaceuticals' nitrofurantoin oral suspension posted as To Be Discontinued on 2026-04-10, which may affect other presentations.

Why (FDA record): FDA inspection records for Alembic Pharmaceuticals Limited FEI 3004956904 show multiple VAI classifications from 2010 through 2020, with the most recent inspection ending 2020-03-13. Alembic is not on FDA's shortage list today.

Our position: Current capsule inventory at East and General covers approximately 26 days. Lakeside inventory is low at 11 days. No capsule shortage is declared by FDA. Alternate manufacturers are available and not on FDA's shortage list.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to evaluate purchase from Alembic Pharmaceuticals Limited as top-ranked alternate; requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition.
2. Buyer to evaluate purchase from Almatica Pharma LLC as second-ranked alternate; requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition.
3. Buyer to evaluate purchase from Alvogen Inc. as third-ranked alternate; requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition.
4. Buyer to evaluate purchase from Aurobindo Pharma Limited as fourth-ranked alternate; requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition.
5. Buyer to evaluate purchase from AvPAK as fifth-ranked alternate; requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition.
6. Buyer to monitor Lakeside inventory daily and coordinate inter-site transfer if needed; requires pharmacy director approval.

Not recommended: No clinical dosing changes or therapeutic substitutions at this time; those decisions remain with treating clinicians and the committee.
